children.name: Hippophae rhamnoides L.
children.description: Note: Rousi (in Ann. Bot. Fenn. 8: 201 - 202, f. 14. 1971) designated J. F. Sacklen s. n. [ex Hort. Academ. Upsal.] in S as lectotype (but in reality a neotype). As original material was in existence, this choice is contrary to Art. 9.11. Rousi recognised that Herb. Burser XXV: 4 (UPS) was original material for the name but identified it as subsp. fluviatilis Soest. Hippophae rhamnoides remains untypified at present.
